snippet.title: Black & White Trailer for Dreamcast
snippet.description: Although this trailer was marked as being for Dreamcast whether the in-game footage actually is the DC is pretty doubtful. The game was never released and to be honest I don't know if it was ever finished, these screens could well be the PC version.
